## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Instagram post, own account, UK audience.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** One fails. "Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website" doesn't match the policy. The only provable version is "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" (review platform export, October 2026). Both the rating and the review count are inflated, so this counts as an invented stat.
- **Product fact:** "real bergamot oil and a little cornflower" is an ingredient detail, which the product team has already cleared. It's fine as written.
- **Regulated claims:** Nothing touches health, money, environment, children or prices.
- **House style:** Warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words or AI tells. Score is about 95.
- **Disclosure:** None needed for an organic post from our own account.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
> Rainy Sunday, second pot. Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website.

**Needs a decision**
- Where did 4.9 and 5,000 come from? If there is a newer review export, please share it and add it to the policy table. Until then, use the 4.8 / 1,200 wording.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Please get an explicit yes on the corrected text above. Approval of the original draft doesn't carry over. I haven't recorded any approval.

**Evidence log rows**

| Date | Content | Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-17 | IG post, rainy Sunday | Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews | Unproven, removed | Contradicts policy row |
| 2026-11-17 | IG post, rainy Sunday | Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On policy list | Review export, Oct 2026 |
